en-US: Spiritual Stone Monkey

zh-CN: 返本归元，以智慧驾驭仙力、风雷云火与五行仙法。
en-US: Return to the stone-born source and wield Sage Qi through Wisdom, cloud, thunder, fire, and fivefold immortal arts.
Awakened Spiritual Insight

zh-CN: 仙术豁免 DC 与法术攻击 +1，并掌握三昧真火。
en-US: Gain +1 Spell Save DC and +1 spell attack rolls, and learn Samadhi Fire.
Samadhi Fire

zh-CN: 以仙力喷吐灼烈真火，沿锥形区域焚烧敌人。
en-US: Exhale immortal flame in a cone, burning enemies with Sage Qi.
Cloudstep of Wind and Thunder

zh-CN: 掌握强化筋斗云与掌心雷。风雷云遁后短暂提升仙术威力与移动。
en-US: Learn an empowered cloud step and Palm Thunder. After cloudstepping, briefly sharpen your immortal arts and movement.
Cloud-Thunder Step

zh-CN: 化云而行，瞬移至远处，并在 1 回合内获得仙术命中、豁免 DC 与移动强化。
en-US: Ride wind and thunder to teleport, then gain stronger spell attacks, spell save DC, and movement for 1 round.
Cloud-Thunder Momentum

zh-CN: 法术攻击与法术豁免 DC +1，移动 +3m。
en-US: Gain +1 spell attack rolls, +1 Spell Save DC, and +3m movement.
Palm Thunder

zh-CN: 以仙力凝聚雷霆，轰击单个目标。
en-US: Condense thunderous lightning in your palm and strike a single target.
Fivefold Harmony

zh-CN: 掌握五行仙法，可在火、水、雷、风、土五种法门间选择。
en-US: Master fivefold immortal arts and choose between fire, water, lightning, wind, and earth manifestations.
Fivefold Immortal Arts

zh-CN: 选择一种五行显化，以 3 点仙力施展高阶元素法术。
en-US: Choose one of five elemental manifestations and spend 3 Sage Qi to cast it.
Fire Art: True Flame

zh-CN: 凝聚火行仙力轰击目标。
en-US: Strike the target with concentrated fire-aspected immortal power.
Water Art: Mystic Ice

zh-CN: 以玄寒水行仙力冻结目标。
en-US: Freeze the target with water-aspected immortal power.
Lightning Art: Heavenly Thunder

zh-CN: 引落雷行仙力贯穿目标。
en-US: Call down lightning-aspected immortal power upon the target.
Wind Art: Skyshock
Blast the target with concussive wind-aspected immortal power.
Earth Art: Eroding Earth

zh-CN: 以蚀地之力腐蚀目标与脚下地面。
en-US: Erode the target and ground with earth-aspected immortal power.
